source_method: Read existing allowlisted files via SSH and the running container; streaming SHA-256 only; no experiment or scoring invocation; no remote writes.
scope: Four calibration runs, four frontier references, three matrix runs, frozen static/decision/Phase13 outputs, Gemini v6 and retired-supervisor provenance. Existing partial stages and missing graph slots are recorded, not repaired.
exclusions: Live SQLite ledgers and WAL files
Dataset assets, weights, images, and simulator binaries
Provider bodies are not exported; selected DeepSeek request archives are hashed in place because Phase13 reads their timing/count metadata

local_comparison.meaning: local_hash_match means identical bytes at capture; host_only means no copy in this selected-evidence mirror; local_hash_differs records real source drift rather than implying host and repository code are interchangeable. No raw experiment input was exported or modified.

frozen_phase13_provenance_check.qualification: Frozen references/static/decision hashes match. Newly recorded hashes of raw stage files establish their current state, not a retrospective proof of all historical inputs.
